title: C06: audit of local transfer, splitting and seed comparisons; explicit c_F, notation repairs, author ledger
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #47

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/47#issuecomment-6828668135, session `ADB991-claude-20261112-8949`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: package C06 of `YM-000026`. Owned chapters changed (all in `manuscript/existence/`): `leaf-transfer.tex`, `cluster-expansion.tex`, `local-splitting.tex`, `mixed-activity-prices.tex`, `seed-energy.tex`, `seed-guides.tex`, `seed-unhit-comparison.tex`. The other 8 owned chapters are unchanged. New report directory: `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C06/`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Claude (Anthropic), running as an autonomous scheduled agent under @ADB991's account.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

I read all 15 C06 chapters in full and rederived every displayed estimate from its stated premises: constants, quantifier order and threshold arithmetic (per-chapter list in `results/C06/findings.md`). **No mathematical error was found.** The changes are local repairs:

- **R1, `leaf-transfer.tex`.** In `eq:leaf-tail-input`, `{\rm nonprincipal}` had been corrupted into a newline followed by `m nonprincipal`, which rendered as italic text. It is now `\mathrm{nonprincipal}`. A scan of all of `manuscript/` found no other instance of this corruption.
- **R2, `seed-energy.tex`.** The final allocation needs the fine linear charge `c_F` of `eq:seed-fine-reserve` to equal the fine-expense coefficient `C_1/L^2` of `eq:seed-hit-input`, but the text only required `C_1/L^2 ≤ λ_f/4`. The choice is now explicit, and the three cancellations are spelled out. Source check: in `YM.Work.E09.assemble`, the single parameter `cF` appears both in `hF` and in the hit hypothesis `g`.
- **R3–R7, notation.** Symbols that were overloaded inside a single chapter are now distinct: the order threshold `z` → `m_0` (cluster), the vacuum site price `v` → `ς` (splitting), the stage factor `d` → `κ` (guides, unhit). The packet counts `H, D, s_ℓ` are renamed to the `H_B, D_B, c_ℓ` that their consumer `packet-estimates.tex` already uses. A wrong symbol for the coupling power (`H^{q_*/2}`) in mixed-activity-prices is corrected. No labels changed.

What remains uncertain or open (see `results/C06/ledger.md`):
- Analytic inputs with no producer label in the manuscript: the nonlinear transition (`eq:transfer-nonlinear-input`), the physical covariance bound (`eq:warning-covariance`) and the local plateau estimates (`eq:warning-plateau`). The path data (`eq:guide-path-input`) and the flat stack (`eq:unhit-flat-stack`) are "assigned to the lattice author", but no package owns them in the inventory.
- Cross-package edges that need acknowledgement from their producers: C05 (singletons, forest price), C01 (A_0 kernel), C08 (raw localized expansion, principal and funding inputs), C07 (packet weight bound).
- Cross-chapter notation clashes (the swapped roles of `h` and `H` in the seed chapters, `D_L`, `τ`, `D`) are proposed to G05 rather than changed. Literature leads for the cluster-expansion chapter (Penrose tree-graph identity; Kotecký–Preiss) are passed to G03 and were not verified.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base `codex/existence-monograph` at `01ef22c`. All 15 initial hashes matched `coverage-inventory.json`.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `latexmk -pdf … -outdir=<scratch> existence.tex`: exit 0, 874 pages, no undefined references, no overfull boxes. There is one warning, an amsmath `\atopwithdelims` warning from `positive-row-producer.tex`, which is outside C06 and was already present. The tracked PDF was not touched. The edited pages (228, 232, 237, 263) were rendered and inspected.
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: OK.
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - Text reads of `Lean/YM/Work/E09.lean` and `E09/Budget.lean`.
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration or `#print axioms`, because Mathlib sources are blocked in this sandbox and the clean build is #37. The literature leads were not opened. No independent review was done.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: no label or statement changed. Prior conditional passes recorded at `seed-guides` `32c815ad…` and `seed-unhit-comparison` `6a1aa82f…` no longer match because of the notation edits. The final hashes are in `results/C06/handoff.md`.
